verdict.rationale: FreeAgent is presented as a hosted SaaS accounting service, reached through its web app, mobile app and the hosted api.freeagent.com and sandbox endpoints. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted, on-premises or downloadable deployment. Self-hosting is a fair question for business software, so the axis applies, and with no evidence of it the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
